Nina Patel (CSM): Quick heads-up: BeaconWorks usage dropped to near-zero since 2024-06-20. Renewal ~9w. Procurement flagged an internal infra consolidation.
Diego Ramos (AE): Noted. Any errors or 4xx/5xx from our side?
Ethan Cole (Support): Logs show last successful call 06/20 07:12 UTC. After that, a handful of 502s then no traffic. No billing flags.
Priyanka Shah (Solutions): Could be header stripping by their service mesh. Also possible they're running an A/B with another provider for latency.
Nina Patel (CSM): I emailed their technical lead asking for confirmation and offered a 20-min "keep-now-online" ops session. CC'd procurement.
redwood-bot: Reminder — open renewal-watch RW-2024-411 and link to account beaconworks.
Diego Ramos (AE): RW-2024-411 created. I'll request the shortlist and timeline from procurement. If they're running a competitor PoC, escalate.
Ethan Cole (Support): Found three denied egress at 06/20 07:20 from their gateway IPs (403). Sharing snippet in thread.
Priyanka Shah (Solutions): I'll draft a single-page comparison: our tiled latency + optimized embed config vs typical self-hosted Faiss+Lambda path.
Nina Patel (CSM): Offer: 2-week Dedicated pilot (no-cost) + migration concierge. If they accept, lock a trial SLA.
Diego Ramos (AE): Good. Also ask if they have a golden eval set — we'll run apples-to-apples.
Nina Patel (CSM): Scheduling ops sync for tomorrow 08:30 PT with infra + procurement + AE. Will update after call.
